sections.body: Growing up means learning to do things yourself: packing your school bag, tying shoelaces, getting dressed.
A checklist helps: lunchbox, water bottle, homework, coat. Tick them off! ✅
Shoelaces: cross the laces, tuck one under, pull tight, make 'bunny ears' and cross them over!
Make a checklist for your school bag and stick it by the door.
Give extra time in the morning so your child can practise. Doing it themselves, slowly, builds confidence.

quiz.q: What helps you remember everything for school?
hints: A list of things to pack.
A shopping list helps grown-ups remember everything. What helps for your school bag?
quiz.explain: A checklist helps you remember everything.

quiz.q: You have 5 coins and buy a sticker for 3. How many coins are left?
hints: If you had 4 coins and spent 1, you'd have 3 left.
